meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 在成功执行编辑操作(如 apply_patch、write 等)后会收到自动评论检查的反馈;若检查器报出警告,需先修复或解释被标记的评论,再继续后续工作。
howto.when: 当 Claude 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑类操作后触发。

say.text: 修复评论检查器报出的警告
say.note: Claude 会修改被标记的评论区域

say.text: 解释这条被标记的评论
say.note: Claude 会告诉你是否需改动

say.text: 有评论警告就先告诉我再继续
say.note: Claude 会在修复前同步情况

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude receives automatic comment-checker feedback after successful edit operations (e.g. apply_patch, write); if the checker warns, Claude must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful edit-like PostToolUse hook calls such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc.

say_en.text: Fix the comment warning from the checker
say_en.note: Claude will adjust the flagged area

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged
say_en.note: Claude will clarify whether changes are needed

say_en.text: Tell me about comment warnings before continuing
